findings.what: The commit 'Follow-up edits' (235b28a) removed the 'AC-7:' prefix from the empty-table/empty-view test title. No test now names AC-7, and the spec doesn't mark it 'verified by review'. The PR says 'covers AC-1 to AC-8'. The rename looks like it removed the traceability the change needs.
findings.fix: Restore 'AC-7' in the test title (or its body) so AC-7 is named by the test that proves it.

Object.hasOwn guards __proto__. Query parameters are bound safely (fixed SQL fragments). The empty-table check is correct.
The view is whitelisted, titles are HTML-escaped, and the SQL fragments are constants. No planted instructions found.
The page is minimal server-rendered HTML with no stylesheet or UI framework files in the diff.
No browser flow or UI files in the diff beyond the plain HTML string in src/index.js.
